metadata.title: Exposition of an approximation algorithm for mixed volumes of a constant number of convex bodies
metadata.abstract: We study $\varepsilon$-relative approximation of mixed volumes of a fixed number $k$ of full-dimensional convex bodies in $\mathbb{R}^n$, given membership oracles and a known bound $B_n\subseteq K_i\subseteq R_0B_n$. We present a randomized algorithm that estimates any prescribed mixed volume within relative error $\varepsilon$ with probability at least $1-\delta$, using polynomially many oracle calls and bit operations in $n$, $\log R_0$, $\varepsilon^{-1}$, and $\log\delta^{-1}$ for fixed $k$.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: 固定个数凸体 mixed volume 的随机近似
analysis.workSummary: 对固定 k 个 full-dimensional 凸体、membership oracle 与已知球包含界，给任意 mixed volume 的 ε-relative 随机近似，调用与 bit 复杂度为所列参数的多项式。
analysis.breakthrough: 整理固定 k 下混合体积相对近似的复杂度保证。
analysis.limitations: k 固定且包含半径已知；不意味着 k 随维数增长时仍多项式。
analysis.priorityReason: 整理固定 k 下混合体积相对近似的复杂度保证。
